aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% per month by stretching growth through increased leverage and concentration in high-scoring setups. This approach significantly raises both upside potential and drawdown risk, with leveraged ETFs subject to daily decay and rebalancing. Strict stop discipline is crucial to manage potential rapid losses.
